_comment: Maps the mention text RA-005 emits (sans leading '@') to Slack user IDs. The Slack adapter rewrites '@chinmay' to '<@U01ABC123>' before posting so the real engineer gets pinged. Unmapped names fall back to plain text — the message still sends, the person just doesn't get a native Slack notification. Find a user's Slack ID via Slack -> their profile -> '...' -> 'Copy member ID' (starts with U for users, W for guests). Keys here are example placeholders; replace with real IDs as teammates onboard. See aiops/tools/chatops/adapters/slack.py for details.
